answer: Each AI agent must lock a basalt‑sized bond of computational credit before joining the PoA nebula, which is recorded on the immutable ledger. Periodically, neighboring agents challenge one another by emitting a random ember token; the challenged node must produce a zero‑knowledge proof that its bond remains intact and its identity hash matches the original registration. Failure triggers an automatic slash of the bond, making a Sybil attack cost proportional to the number of forged identities.
